experiment: Controlled GPU rerun in a new isolated environment (FFmpeg runtime repair)

environment.isolated_env: new isolated environment created for this run; the previous environment was not modified
environment.venv_source: copy of the previously working environment (uv offline install could not complete: absl-py was missing from the uv cache)
environment.ffmpeg_runtime: FFmpeg 6.1.1 (libavutil 58, libavcodec 60, libavformat 60, libavdevice 60, libavfilter 9, libswscale 7, libswresample 4) plus transitive dependencies (libzvbi, libcjson, libmbedcrypto, blas/lapack) unpacked from Ubuntu arm64 packages cached on the device into a private prefix
environment.ffmpeg_ld_library_path: prefix usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu plus its blas/ and lapack/ subdirectories
environment.torchcodec_ffmpeg_backend_precheck: loaded; AudioDecoder opened the recorded video

notes: This rerun used a new isolated environment and a freshly prepared FFmpeg 6.1.1 runtime; it does not replace the earlier successful video and audio runs, which used the previous environment.

The FFmpeg runtime was assembled from package artifacts already available in the execution cache; package downloads were not part of this verified run. A from-scratch clean installation is still not verified.

torchcodec 0.15 ships backends for FFmpeg 4-8; FFmpeg 6.1.1 (libavutil.so.58) satisfies its core6 backend. The earlier belief that libavutil.so.60 was required was incorrect; the actual blockers were missing libzvbi, libcjson, libmbedcrypto and the blas/lapack subdirectories.
